rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Full re-walk, every pronoun/demonstrative/definite-NP in all six chunks, not just the previously-repaired sentence. Two considered-and-cleared items worth recording: (1) chunk 5 line 43 'That is the orient, fix, compound, close loop cut at more joints' — this exact phrase is never named anywhere IN THIS FILE before this point, which would read as a 'never named' violation under a file-only read; it resolves only via the enclosing module's signposting carve-out (§1: 'vocabulary the enclosing module file's signposting introduced... counts as prior context') — getting-going.md's own Big Idea ('Orient, fix tests-first... retro') and What You'll Learn ('Run an orient → fix → compound → close loop end-to-end') name it first, and this lecture is the module's closing include. Carve-out applies cleanly. (2) chunk 4 line 35 'never the thread' — a metaphor with no prior occurrence of 'thread' anywhere earlier in the file; checked against the 'vague with full history' bar and found it has exactly one inferable referent (via the immediately following clause 'Take the understanding forward'), not multiple competing candidates like the rule's own bad examples ('a system like this', 'what you stored') — passes, but it is genuinely the closest call in the file and worth a maintainer glance. All other referents (the gap/the training/the rules/the strategy doc/the difference is reach/that file/the neighbouring files/the rule sits in ./CLAUDE.local.md/the retro you just ran/his loop) resolve either in-chunk or against chunk 0 / prior chunks per the sequential-deck-read carve-out. No forward pointer to a later slide anywhere.

No chunk points at another file by position. chunk 5's 'The story of building this training is the shape you just ran on your own repo' is a closer summing its own deck (explicitly allowed). Klaassen is introduced fresh with full name + affiliation + claim in one clause ('Kieran Klaassen at Every calls it compound engineering') rather than assumed known from compound-and-close.md — self-contained, passes even though the maintainer block confirms he is also named in that sibling file (deliberate reinforcement, not a callback dependency).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess-before-reveal construction anywhere in the body; this is a narrative closer lecture, not an interactive demo beat.
All six chunks carry multi-paragraph, self-carrying content; none is a bare wait-state or single context-dependent bullet.

All five `##` headers checked against their own chunk's content: 'Wrong is how steering gets in' (chunk 1 — wrongness turns into rules), 'The rules started doing the work' (chunk 2 — rules become load-bearing, session-inherited), 'Then the agents started checking the agents' (chunk 3 — subagents auditing files, four agents auditing while a fifth checks neighbours), 'Built to forgive' (chunk 4 — missing artefacts cost a file, never the understanding), 'You just ran the compound loop' (chunk 5 — direct address confirming the reader just ran it). None contradicted by its chunk's content.

Re-checked every sub-item across all six chunks. 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction: only one 'Not'-led sentence exists in the whole body (line 9, 'Not wrong the way a bad draft is wrong... Wrong the way any first version is wrong...') — a single negation-then-assertion contrast, not the banned two-negations-plus-Z shape (grepped: zero other 'Not ' sentence-starts in the file). Considered and rejected as a near-miss: chunk 5 line 39 'Over ninety minutes, not a year. On a trivial bug, not a whole training.' inverts the banned order (declarative first, then two P-not-Q pairs) and each fragment is a pair, which the rule explicitly allows ('cut to a pair'); it also does the closer's job of scaling the whole-training story down to the session just run. Anaphora/epistrophe triples: chunk 3's 'one person → a subagent → four agents... while a fifth' escalation carries new concrete content on every leg (solo fix, single-file audit, parallel four-plus-one) — passes the third-leg test. Self-grading superlatives: none ('the valuable part' in chunk 1 grades the narrative gap, not the training's own worth to the reader — not a value-prop leak). Number + retraction: none — 'ninety minutes' / 'a year' are a comparison of two distinct real durations, not a hedge-then-walk-back of one number. Abstraction-noun stacks: chunk 3's 'work-per-session' / 'care-per-line' are unpacked with a concrete illustration in the same breath ('a week got made in an afternoon'), not left as vague nominalizations. Verb triplets with an empty leg: none present.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Full dialect inventory across all six chunks against §8's list (surface-as-noun, firing, compendium, forcing function, beat, mood, Connections-as-proper-noun) plus a broader sweep for anything reading as curriculum-authoring-internal: 'surface', 'firing', 'compendium', 'beat', 'mood', and 'Connections'-as-proper-noun are all absent from the body (confirmed by direct read of all six chunks) — the earlier 'compendium'→'checklist' and 'fired'→'went off' swaps hold clean, and 'went off'/'passage' (line 13) are ordinary English with no repo-internal taxonomy standing (grepped: 'passage' is used in its dictionary sense dozens of times across this repo's own eval-judge files). The one remaining list-term hit is chunk 1 line 11, one of three quoted rule-exhibits: *"Forcing functions stay, scripted reactions go."* Evaluated against the amended carve-out and ACCEPTED, not deferred to the maintainer note — see accompanying report for full reasoning; short form: the sentence frame ('Each thing pointed at turned into a rule' + three verbatim quotes) exhibits real compendium rules as specimens of what a correction became, not narration reaching for 'forcing function' as vocabulary to explain a concept, and the amended §8 text uses this file's own sentence shape as its illustrative example of the carve-out. Independently, the audience-register clause clears the term for AE101 engineer ICs regardless. Checked all three quotes for other list-term hits (none) and confirmed no other body sentence uses 'forcing function' outside this one attested, verbatim, backing-block-locked quote. Terms considered and cleared as NOT internal dialect: 'subagent', 'plan mode' (Claude Code product vocabulary, not curriculum-authoring jargon, explicitly cleared for this file's engineer register in the maintainer block), 'load-bearing'/'compound'/'compound engineering' (externally-attested Klaassen vocabulary, explained in-line, the lecture's taught subject matter), 'auditing'/'checklist'/'cohort'/'retro'/'workbook'/'module' (plain English or legitimate navigational/structural terms the student already holds).
